component.name: ScreenCatch
component.summary: Take a screenshot and annotate it instantly

description.p: ScreenCatch combines taking a screenshot and marking it up into one quick step. Press the shortcut, drag over the part of the screen you need, then add arrows, boxes, circles and text before copying or saving the result.

ul.li: Region selection over a frozen screen, with resize handles and pixel size readout
Arrow, rectangle, ellipse, line, pen, highlighter, text and numbered step tools
Pixelate tool to hide sensitive information
Crop, undo and redo, move or recolor any annotation
Copy to the clipboard or save as PNG with one key
Global keyboard shortcut set up automatically on GNOME
Works on Wayland and X11 through the desktop screenshot portal
